leaves.name: legendreJonesPall
leaves.doc: Legendre's three-square theorem with the refinement cited by Tian-Yuan-Zhang (arXiv:1411.4728v1, source L533): a squarefree n = 1, 3 mod 8 is a^2+b^2+c^2 with 4 | c when n = 1 mod 8 (Jones-Pall, Acta Math. 70 (1939) 165-191, Theorem 5, as cited by TYZ; wording of that theorem UNVERIFIED)

leaves.source: Legendre (three squares); Jones-Pall, Acta Math. 70 (1939) 165-191, Theorem 5 (cited by TYZ L533)
